## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-b)

Head-sha: fa4ec1b61b77508cbde5e03d0bab84534dd252aa · read 2026-11-21T03:37Z

### 维护者速读

- 可以合：管理员打开只读包自带的列表视图时，底部「计算」菜单和「重命名」不再出现，避免点了必被服务器拒绝再回滚的体验；自定义包里的共享视图、个人视图照旧。
- 判断依据和 Studio 入口用的是同一份「这个包能不能写」的结论，不额外发请求；读不到时菜单照旧出现（服务器仍会拒绝），最坏情况就是回到改动前的样子。
- 卡上「其他保存入口」（视图设置面板的保存、管理视图里的置顶/设默认/删除）这次没动，按席位裁定 A 移到 #35974，PR 正文写明了。

### Must-fix

None.

### Should-fix

- S1 (text): the body's local runs name head `bfa65e89`, which is not in this PR's history (the three commits are `806b530f`, `d2d160cd`, `fa4ec1b6`), so I could not diff it against the final head. CI is green on `fa4ec1b6` and covers the same suites; one line saying the local runs predate the rebase (or re-stating them at `fa4ec1b6`) would make the record match the head.

### Checked

- l1-face on `fa4ec1b6`: clean (45 checks success, 0 failed, mergeable clean, Clause-② no).
- `ObjectView.tsx`: `!activeViewPackageRefusesSaves` sits on both the shared-view `rename` gate and the `pickSummary` gate; `activeSavedViewRow` is looked up only for an admin on an active view, so non-admins pay no package read.
- `usePackageRefusesSaves` answers true only for posture `'view'`; in flight, failed read, a package the list leaves out, and a null id all stay savable. That is the fail-open the card and the body describe, and the server refusal still stands behind it.
- `studioPackageId` is now exported from `utils/appRoute.ts` but not from the package entry; `sys_metadata` and missing ids map to null (personal view, unbound stored view keep the menu).
- `data-objectstack` `listViews`: both arms carry the served `_packageId`; the bare-spec arm returns the same object when there is nothing to add, so existing identity-based callers see no change. Return type unchanged (Clause-② no holds).
- Tests: 6 `ObjectView` cases (read-only package hides both; customization package, unbound, personal, unread list, failed read keep the pick) and 3 adapter cases; the body's ablations name which case goes red for each of the three gates.
- Scope: card #35933 also names "any other view-saving entry"; the panel Save and Manage views pin/default/delete are moved to #35974 under the seat's ruling A, and the Acceptance notes say so. Kernel-package views keep the menu (verdict unknown client-side), also stated.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch; its sentences match the code. Metadata-protocol none is right (no authorable metadata).
- Overlap with #35918 and #35910 on `ObjectView.tsx`: the body reports a clean merge with both; whichever lands second owes the usual merge-only delta.

### Owed

- Browser check: NOT MEASURED here, as the body says; the refusal path itself is browser-measured on #35919 `rt-07`. Not blocking for an L1.
- L1 does not replace an L2.
